description: The check runner of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-21, docs/PROOF-CHECKS.md): what runs (trust, edits), the attempt loop (never re-run a failure, re-runs on a changed tree, unreliable, repeat), timeouts, cancel, the reaper and its process table walk, the receipt of each attempt and the roll-up through pack.mjs (lib/proof/check-runner.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-checks.mjs.

mutations.name: PC-edited-runs
mutations.what: a file edited since the baseline still runs its baseline checks

mutations.name: PC-untrusted-unblocked
mutations.what: an untrusted file is not reported as blocked

mutations.name: PC-edit-unseen
mutations.what: an edit of the file is not noticed

mutations.name: PC-blocked-runs
mutations.what: a blocked file still runs what resolveAcceptance gave

mutations.name: PC-retry-failure
mutations.what: a failing attempt is run again until repeat is reached

patches.new: if (!done.attempt.passed && number >= check.repeat) break; // never run again

mutations.name: PC-reruns-more
mutations.what: a check changing the tree is run again three times

mutations.name: PC-reruns-const
mutations.what: three re-runs on a new tree

mutations.name: PC-no-unreliable
mutations.what: a check that keeps changing the tree is not marked unreliable

mutations.name: PC-ignore-tree-change
mutations.what: a passing attempt that changed the tree counts like any other

mutations.name: PC-no-count-reset
mutations.what: passes before a change of the tree still count towards repeat

mutations.name: PC-repeat-one
mutations.what: repeat is ignored

mutations.name: PC-error-stops-all
mutations.what: a check ShellRunner refused stops every check after it

mutations.name: PC-error-dropped
mutations.what: the refusal of ShellRunner is not reported

mutations.name: PC-timeout-uncapped
mutations.what: the timeout of the file is reported without the cap of ShellRunner

mutations.name: PC-capped-flag
mutations.what: a capped timeout is not marked

mutations.name: PC-timeout-seconds
mutations.what: the timeout is read as milliseconds

mutations.name: PC-cancel-flag
mutations.what: a cancel is not reported

mutations.name: PC-cancel-throws
mutations.what: a cancel before a run throws instead of stopping

mutations.name: PC-tree-after-signal
mutations.what: the tree after a cancelled attempt is cancelled too, so the attempt is not recorded

mutations.name: PC-no-reap
mutations.what: what a check leaves behind is not reaped

patches.old: const reap = await reapAttempt({ pid: result.pid, spawnedAt, rows: watch?.rows ?? [], platform, processTree });
patches.new: const reap = { method: null, left: null, leftovers: null };

mutations.name: PC-no-watch
mutations.what: the Windows process table is not read while the attempt runs

mutations.name: PC-reap-dead-rows
mutations.what: the Windows reaper treats processes seen earlier as alive

mutations.name: PC-reap-no-kill
mutations.what: the Windows reaper finds the processes but kills none

patches.old: for (const row of alive) await processTree.kill(row.pid);

mutations.name: PC-posix-no-kill
mutations.what: the POSIX reaper does not signal the process group

patches.old: try { process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL'); } catch { /* gone in between */ }

mutations.name: PC-walk-first-holder
mutations.what: a reused pid adopts the children of its new holder

mutations.name: PC-walk-older-child
mutations.what: a process older than its parent pid's holder is taken as its child

mutations.name: PC-walk-root-slack
mutations.what: any process with the shell's pid is taken as the shell

mutations.name: PC-walk-no-standin
mutations.what: the children of a shell the table never saw are not found

mutations.name: PC-walk-one-pass
mutations.what: the walk stops after one pass over the table

mutations.name: PC-tree-unknown-false
mutations.what: an unknown tree is reported as unchanged

mutations.name: PC-passed-exit
mutations.what: a pass is exit 0 whatever the file expects

mutations.name: PC-check-changes-fn
mutations.what: the check-changes function is handed to the roll-up instead of its report

patches.old: const report = typeof checkChanges === 'function' ? await checkChanges({ finalTree: final }) : checkChanges;

mutations.name: PC-ledger-missing
mutations.what: a ledger never written makes the roll-up throw

mutations.name: PC-no-toolchain
mutations.what: the toolchain versions are not recorded

patches.old: const versions = toolchain ? await toolchain.versions((await runner.workspace.resolve('')).root) : null;

mutations.name: PC-cwd-root
mutations.what: every check runs in the workspace root

mutations.name: PC-output-budget
mutations.what: the capture budget asked for is not passed on

mutations.name: PC-attempt-number
mutations.what: every attempt is numbered 1
